summary_1line: Rama proposes performing the Rajasuya sacrifice, but Bharata respectfully argues against it due to the destruction and conflict it would cause among kings.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama sits in the royal court embracing Bharata and Lakshmana while announcing his wish to perform the mighty Rajasuya sacrifice.
Bharata stands with folded palms before Rama in the court, earnestly arguing that the Rajasuya would destroy many royal houses.
